
{{nm}}  {data-navmenu="Surveys"}
================================================================================

```{r}
d <- subset(obs_pred$index, survey == "{{nm}}")
```



Row {.tabset}
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### Aggregate index

```{r}
d |> 
  group_by(year, model) |> 
  summarise(
    obs = if (any(is.finite(obs))) sum(obs, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
    pred = if (any(is.finite(pred))) sum(pred, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
    is_proj = unique(is_proj),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    obs = ifelse(obs == 0, NA, obs)
  ) |> 
  plot_obs_pred_report(
    color = ~model,
    colors = cols,
    ylab = "Aggregate index"
  )
```

### Index-at-age

```{r}
plot_obs_pred_report(d, frame = ~age, color = ~model,
                     colors = cols, ylab = "Index")
```

### Catchability

```{r}
qest <- plot_rows(d, "q")
u_qest <- unique(qest[, c("model", "age", "q")])
if (any(duplicated(u_qest[, c("model", "age")]))) {
  u_qest <- unique(qest[, c("model", "age", "year", "q")])
  if (nrow(u_qest)) plot_trend(u_qest, x = ~age, y = ~q, xlab = "Age", color = ~model, colors = cols, frame = ~year) else plotly::plot_ly()
} else {
  if (nrow(u_qest)) plot_trend(u_qest, x = ~age, y = ~q, xlab = "Age", color = ~model, colors = cols) else plotly::plot_ly()
}
```
